items.label: US Proudly Assembled in Florida, USA
items.value: Each Fusion5 Helios 10 windows tablet is meticulously assembled in Pasco County, Florida, ensuring American-level quality, faster logistics, and confidence in every unit. A premium windows tablet pc built with care.

items.label: 158% Faster Than PRO N5
items.value: Equipped with the Intel15th Gen Alder Lake N150 processor, delivering up to 158% performance improvement over PRO N5 for smoother multitasking, faster workflows, and demanding applications.

items.label: Active Cooling Fan for Heavy Workloads
items.value: An integrated built-in cooling fan maintains stable performance, prevents overheating, and avoids throttling—ideal for productivity, multitasking, and extended use of this high-performance pc tablet.

items.label: 10.1" FHD+ Display (1920×1200, 400 Nits)
items.value: Enjoy sharp, vivid visuals with a taller 16:10 aspect ratio for better productivity, streaming, reading, and browsing in a compact, highly portable 10 inch tablet design.

items.label: 12GB DDR5 RAM + 512GB SSD Storage
items.value: Next-gen DDR5 memory ensures smooth multitasking while the high-speed SSD provides fast boot times and ample storage for apps, files, and media on this versatile computer tablet.

items.label: 36W USB-C PD Fast Charging + Long Battery Life
items.value: Features a 7.6V 4500mAh battery with 36W Power Delivery, enabling fast recharging and dependable all-day use.

items.label: Full-Function Connectivity
items.value: Includes 2× full-function USB-C ports, USB 3.0, Micro HDMI output, and 3.5mm headphone jack for maximum flexibility.

items.label: Premium Metal Body – Assembled in USA
items.value: Designed with a durable metal casing, professional finish, CE & FCC compliant materials, and the reliable build quality you expect from a premium tablet computer.

items.label: Windows 11 Home Pre-Installed
items.value: Step into the ultimate tablet pc windows 11 experience. Your new windows 11 tablet is ready to use right out of the box, offering a seamless tablet windows 11 ecosystem optimized for productivity, security, and compatibility.

items.label: Trusted by Over 2 Million Customers - Established Brand Since 2010
items.value: Fusion5 is one of the world’s longest standing tablet PC brands, founded in 2010 and among the top 5 oldest in the industry. With over 2 million happy customers globally, we bring legacy, quality, and innovation together.
